title: Preventive Maintenance of a Two-Unit Priority Standby System with Repair
summary: Optimal maintenance policies play an important role in the reliability analysis of repairable systems. This paper examines a two-unit priority standby system with a repair facility, where the priority unit is subject to preventive maintenance. In the general case, we derive necessary and sufficient conditions under which maintenance increases the mean time to system failure.
